body: claimed: agy research (gemini) · 2026-11-15 19:46 UTC · plan: research

Research is complete for Okuma OSP controls (OSP-P200M, OSP-P300M, OSP-P500) and the GENOS M560-V and M660-V mills. This research uses only CamCraft code, public Okuma manuals, public Okuma spec sheets, and RS-274/ISO 6983. It uses no Autodesk or HSMWorks material.

## Open questions: answers

### 1. Dialect vs Fanuc
- **File extension and wrapper:** OSP main programs use the `.MIN` extension. Data transfers can start with `$NAME.MIN%` and end with `%`. Set `extension = "min"` in `okuma-osp.cps` (`crates/post/src/post/engine.rs::extension_of`, `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs`).
- **Program number and comments:** OSP accepts `O` numbers (`O0001` to `O9999`) and uppercase ASCII comments inside `( ... )`. CamCraft already restricts `O` numbers to `1..=9999` and comments to 40 ASCII characters without `(`, `)`, `%`, `;`, or `*` (`crates/app/src/posting_program.rs`).
- **Tool length offset (`G56`) and cancel (`G53`) hazard:** `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` writes `G43 H<n>` to apply tool length offset and `G49` to cancel it. On OSP-P200M/P300M, **`G56 H<n>`** activates Z tool length offset and **`G53` cancels tool length offset** (Okuma OSP Programming Manual). OSP `G53` does NOT select machine coordinates. Never output Fanuc `G00 G53 Z0` alone. Pair cancel with `G15 H0` (machine coordinate zero offset) or use `G30 P1` (stored home position).
- **Work offsets (`G15 H`):** CamCraft emits `PARAM WorkOffset` as `"G54"` to `"G59"` (`crates/app/src/operation/types/sel.rs::WCS_SLOTS`). `okuma-osp.cps` must map `"G54"`..`"G59"` to `G15 H1`..`G15 H6` (`heidenhain.cps` and `sinumerik.cps` pattern; `crates/app/tests/sinumerik_work_offsets.rs`). It must refuse unknown offset names by name.
- **Tool change (`M06 T` and next tool):** On OSP-P300M, calling `T<n> M06` when tool `<n>` is already in the spindle causes an ATC alarm. Track the active tool across sections and skip `T<n> M06` for consecutive ops that share a tool (plus optional `VTLCN` system-variable guard). Note a CamCraft engine gap: `crates/post/src/post/js.rs` and `crates/post/src/post/mod.rs` provide no `NextTool` parameter or lookahead hook. Pre-staging `T<next>` after `M06` waits for future stream support.
- **Program end (`M02` / `M30`):** `fanuc.cps` ends with `G91 G28 Z0`, `G28 X0 Y0`, `M30`, `%`. On OSP, stop the spindle (`M05`) and coolant (`M09`), retract safely (`G15 H0 G53 Z<safe>` or `G30 P1`), and end with `M02` (standard OSP main program end) or `M30` (reset and rewind). Drop `G91 G28`.
- **Units (`G20` / `G21`):** On OSP, `G20` (inch) and `G21` (metric) confirm the NC unit parameter and alarm when units mismatch without the switchable-unit option. Emit `G21` (or `G20` via `EndUnits`, `crates/app/tests/post_unit_word.rs`) under a `writeUnitCode` post property so single-unit controls can omit it.
- **`explains` flag:** `crates/post/src/post/explain.rs` hardcodes Fanuc meanings (`G53` as machine coordinates, `G43`/`G49` as length offset). Leave `explains` unset in `okuma-osp.cps` until `explain.rs` supports per-dialect words.

### 2. Canned cycles and arc format
- **Return planes (`G71 Z` + `M52`/`M53`/`M54`):** `fanuc.cps` uses `G98` and `G99`. OSP uses `G71 Z<clearance>` (sets clearance height with no Z move) together with **`M53`** (return to `G71 Z`), **`M54`** (return to `R` point, like `G99`), or `M52` (return to Z upper limit).
- **Drilling, peck, tap, and bore cycles (OSP-P200M/P300M Programming Manual):**
  - `G81`: spot and standard drill.
  - `G82`: counterbore with dwell. OSP `G04`, `G82`, and `G89` read dwell `P` in **seconds** (for example `P0.5`), whereas `fanuc.cps` outputs milliseconds. Convert `P` to seconds.
  - `G73` and `G83`: high-speed chip-break peck and full-retract deep peck. OSP supports `Q` (constant positive peck depth; takes priority over `I`/`J`) or `I`, `J`, `K`. Ensure clearance `K` never exceeds peck `Q` (avoids OSP Alarm 2281).
  - `G284` / `G274` (and `G84` / `G74`): synchronized rigid tapping (`G284` RH, `G274` LH; `G84`/`G74` standard tap). Command `F = RPM * pitch` in `G94`, set `M53` or `M54`, and cancel with `G80`.
  - `G85` (feed in, feed out), `G86` (feed in, spindle stop, rapid out), `G89` (feed in, dwell `P` seconds, feed out), `G76` / `G87` (fine and back bore with `I`/`J`/`Q` shift).
- **Arc format:** `G17`/`G18`/`G19` with `G02`/`G03` and incremental start-to-center `I`, `J`, `K` match `fanuc.cps` and ISO 6983. Full 360-degree circles require `I`, `J`, `K`. Native OSP radius arcs use **`L`** (not Fanuc `R`), so post `I`/`J`/`K` centers only.

### 3. Coolant, TSC, air blast, spindle, and high-speed mode
- **Coolants and air (Okuma OSP-P300M / GENOS M-code tables):**
  - Flood: `M08` on, `M09` off.
  - Mist: `M07` on, `M09` off.
  - Through-spindle coolant (TSC): `M50` low pressure on, `M51` high pressure on, `M09` off (replaces `M88`/`M89` used in Doosan/Haas Fanuc dialects).
  - Air blast: `M59` chip air blow on (`M58` or `M09` off, ladder-dependent; through-spindle air purge uses builder codes such as `M339`; `M12` is rotary clamp on mills or M-spindle stop on lathes). Look up M-codes from `machine.coolants` first (`assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps` pattern), with documented OSP defaults when no machine is mounted.
- **Spindle:** `M03` CW, `M04` CCW, `M05` stop, `M19` orient, `S<rpm>`. Support `millSpindleReverse = true` and `Machine` spindle range checks.
- **High-speed mode (`G131` / `G130` Super-NURBS / Hi-Cut Pro):** `G131` enables high-speed contouring with `F` (upper feed limit), `E` (tolerance from `PARAM Smoothing`), and `J` mode (`J1` finish, `J2` rough from `PARAM SmoothingMode`). `G130` cancels it. Because `G131` alarms if the Super-NURBS software option is absent, keep it opt-in behind a post property.

### 4. Machine data: GENOS M560-V and GENOS M660-V (Okuma brochures and spec sheets)
- **GENOS M560-V:**
  - Travels X / Y / Z: `1,050 × 560 × 460 mm` (`41.34 × 22.05 × 18.11 in`).
  - Table size and max load: `1,300 × 560 mm` (`51.18 × 22.05 in`), `900 kg` (`1,980 lbs`).
  - Spindle: CAT40 / BT40 BIG-PLUS, `50` to `15,000 min^-1` standard (options `8,000` / `12,000`), `22 / 18.5 kW` (`30 / 25 hp`), rigid tapping standard.
  - Rapids: X/Y `40,000 mm/min` (`40 m/min`), Z `32,000 mm/min` (`32 m/min`).
  - Max cutting feedrate: `32,000 mm/min` (`32 m/min`) on X, Y, Z.
  - ATC: `20` tools standard / `32` common configuration; max tool diameter `90 mm` adjacent full / `125 mm` adjacent empty; max tool length `300 mm`; max tool weight `8 kg`.
- **GENOS M660-V:**
  - Travels X / Y / Z: `1,500 × 660 × 660 mm` (`59.05 × 25.98 × 25.98 in`).
  - Table size, max load, nose height: `1,530 × 660 mm` (`60.24 × 25.98 in`), `1,500 kg` (`3,300 lbs`), spindle nose to table `150` to `810 mm`.
  - Spindle: CAT40 BIG-PLUS `50` to `15,000 min^-1` standard (`22 / 18.5 kW`, `30 / 25 hp`); optional CAT50 BIG-PLUS `12,000 min^-1` (`35 / 25 hp`); rigid tapping standard.
  - Rapids: X/Y `40,000 mm/min` (`40 m/min`), Z `32,000 mm/min` (`32 m/min`).
  - Max cutting feedrate: `32,000 mm/min` (`32 m/min`) on X, Y, Z.
  - ATC: `32` tools standard (option `48`); CAT40 max tool diameter `90 mm` adjacent full / `125 mm` adjacent empty; max tool length `400 mm`; max tool weight `8 kg`.
- **CamCraft `.mch` constraints (`crates/post/src/machine/def.rs`, `tooling.rs`, `docs/MACHINE-ONBOARDING.md`):**
  - `parse_mch` requires standard JSON without `//` comments.
  - `Machine` has no table size or table load fields; put those figures in `general.description` and docs.
  - `SPINDLE_MOUNTS` lists `"BT30"`, `"BT40"`, `"CAT40"`, and `"TTS"` (no `"CAT50"` yet). Model the standard CAT40 configurations first.

### 5. What `fanuc.cps` gets right vs what must change
- **Keep from `fanuc.cps` and `mazak.cps`:** manifest structure (`vendor = "Camcraft"`, `programUnits`, `coolantModes`, `afterModes`, `axisInversion`, `millSpindleReverse`), `O` header comments, `safeRetractZ` and `OriginX/Y/Z` plumbing, `G17`/`G18`/`G19` modal plane tracking, `G00`/`G01`/`G02`/`G03` with `I`/`J`/`K` arcs, `G41`/`G42`/`G40` with `D`, and `S` / `M03` / `M04` spindle logic.
- **Change for `okuma-osp.cps`:**
  1. Set `extension = "min"`, support an optional `$NAME.MIN%` wrapper, and end with `M02`/`M30` without `G91 G28`.
  2. Use `G56 H<n>` for length offset, use `G53` for cancel, and pair retract moves with `G15 H0` or `G30 P1`.
  3. Map `"G54".."G59"` to `G15 H1`..`G15 H6` and refuse unknown offsets by name.
  4. Skip duplicate `T<n> M06` calls on consecutive same-tool sections and add an optional `VTLCN` guard.
  5. Replace `G98`/`G99` with `G71 Z` + `M53`/`M54`, convert `P` dwell to seconds, and emit `G284`/`G274` for rigid tapping.
  6. Read `machine.coolants` first with OSP defaults (`M08`, `M07`, `M51`, `M59`, `M09`).
  7. Gate `G20`/`G21` confirmation via `writeUnitCode` and keep `G131`/`G130` behind an opt-in property.
  8. Remove Fanuc Macro B probing (`#5061..`, `G10 L2`, `probeAxisInversion`), refuse probe ops in slice 1, and leave `explains` off.

---

## Design proposal

Deliver support in four incremental slices:
1. **Slice 1 (Core 3-axis OSP post):** Build `assets/posts/okuma-osp.cps` from the `mazak.cps` / `doosan-dnm.cps` pattern. Include core milling, `G15 H1..H6`, `G56 H`, safe `G15 H0 G53`/`G30 P1` retract, `G71 Z` + `M53`/`M54` cycles, `G284`/`G274` rigid tap, seconds dwell `P`, OSP coolants, and duplicate-tool skip. Refuse probe ops by name and keep `explains` and `G131` disabled by default. Register in `BUILTINS` (`crates/app/src/posting.rs`), `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs`, and OSP dialect tests.
2. **Slice 2 (Machine files):** Add CAT40 `assets/machines/okuma-genos-m560v.mch` and `assets/machines/okuma-genos-m660v.mch`. Register both in `MACHINES` and test against published specs (`tormach_machines.rs` pattern).
3. **Slice 3 (Air-cut tester kit):** Add `docs/tester-kits/okuma-osp/` with `README.md`, a test project, a golden `.min` file, and a Rust test (`microarc_test_part.rs` pattern).
4. **Slice 4 (Opt-in OSP features):** Add opt-in `G131`/`G130` Super-NURBS smoothing and native Okuma touch-probing (`CALL OO..` / `G31` / `VC`) in separate issues. Defer engine `NextTool` lookahead, `CAT50` mount support, and dialect-aware `explain.rs` until requested.

---

## Sub-issues

1. **Add okuma-osp.cps 3-axis milling post with conformance goldens**
   - Adds `assets/posts/okuma-osp.cps`, `BUILTINS` entry, conformance goldens, and OSP dialect safety tests (`G56`/`G53`, `G15 H`, `G71 Z`/`M53`/`M54`, `G284`, seconds dwell, probe refusal).
   - Done means: `okuma-osp.cps` passes all 3-axis conformance goldens byte-exact, passes OSP offset/retract/cycle/unit tests, and refuses probe ops cleanly.
   - Proposed: `P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`.

2. **Add Okuma GENOS M560-V and M660-V CAT40 machine files**
   - Adds `okuma-genos-m560v.mch` and `okuma-genos-m660v.mch`, registers them in `MACHINES`, and tests published specs.
   - Done means: both `.mch` files parse without comments, list in `MACHINES`, pass `machine_library.rs`, and match published CAT40 Okuma limits in Rust tests.
   - Proposed: `P6`, `effort:medium`, `area:post`.

3. **Add Okuma OSP air-cut shop tester kit**
   - Adds `docs/tester-kits/okuma-osp/` (`README.md`, project, golden `.min`, and Rust verification test) for air-cut validation on OSP mills.
   - Done means: the tester kit builds and posts a golden `.min` program via Rust test with an air-cut-first safety checklist and shop feedback form.
   - Proposed: `P6`, `effort:medium`, `area:post`.

4. **Support Okuma OSP G131/G130 Super-NURBS smoothing in okuma-osp.cps**
   - Adds opt-in `G131` (`F`, `J`, `E`) and `G130` high-speed contouring output driven by CamCraft `Smoothing` and `SmoothingMode`.
   - Done means: smoothing stays off by default, writes valid `G131`/`G130` blocks on rough and finish ops when enabled, cancels before tool change or end, and passes smoothing tests.
   - Proposed: `P7`, `effort:high`, `area:post`.

5. **Support Okuma OSP touch-probe routines in okuma-osp.cps**
   - Replaces the slice-1 probe refusal in `okuma-osp.cps` with OSP probing (`CALL OO..` / `G31` / `VC`) and `probeAxisInversion` checks.
   - Done means: probe ops output verified OSP probe routines with `VC` variables and `G15 H` updates instead of Fanuc Macro B, pinned by probe tests.
   - Proposed: `P7`, `effort:high`, `area:post`.

Filed the five sub-issues below for this umbrella:

1. #1964 — Add okuma-osp.cps 3-axis milling post with conformance goldens (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:post`)
2. #1967 — Add Okuma GENOS M560-V and M660-V CAT40 machine files (`P6`, `effort:medium`, `area:post`)
3. #1971 — Add Okuma OSP air-cut shop tester kit (`P6`, `effort:medium`, `area:post`)
4. #1972 — Support Okuma OSP G131/G130 Super-NURBS smoothing in okuma-osp.cps (`P7`, `effort:high`, `area:post`)
5. #1975 — Support Okuma OSP touch-probe routines in okuma-osp.cps (`P7`, `effort:high`, `area:post`)

This umbrella remains open for maintainer review before closing.
